who: Henry J. (Henry Jack) Tobias, historian of Russia, formerly University of New Mexico; PhD Stanford.

The authority identifies Henry J. (Henry Jack) Tobias, cites his 1958 dissertation The origins and evolution of the Jewish Bund until 1901, and links the same obituary.

notes: Matching doctorate institution, dissertation year, field and New Mexico employment identify the candidate. His move to Oklahoma in 1969 preceded the listed student completion in 1970.
